reason: We already pay for Claude and Codex and their cloud agents can already run on a schedule. For anything beyond that I can write a cron job with claude -p in an afternoon, so I am not adding another tool or another $99 a month.
objection: It is pre-alpha and built by one developer. I am not putting client repos into a pipeline that might disappear in six months, and the vendors will probably ship the same thing anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run for months on a team like mine and save real hours each week compared with the vendor's own scheduling, with no setup cost to try the self-hosted version.
